nodes.summary: Let $S$ be a store of $n$ cells, each empty or holding a node, in which the cells $x$ and $y$ are allocated, the next pointer of $y$ is not NIL, and the cell $w$ it points to is allocated. Sentinel insertion of $x$ after $y$ performs four pointer assignments in order, each costing one time unit, and returns the resulting store: set the next pointer of $x$ to the next pointer of $y$; set the previous pointer of $x$…
